verdicts.question: Is the cable routing in the site photos continuous and consistent across the documented run — from rooftop panels to DCDB to inverter to ACDB to solar meter to main panel — with no orphan ends, no unexplained mid-run size changes, and visible conduit / cable-tie / clipping where the run is exposed?
verdicts.designer_notes: No designer answer for this target — the vision routine verifies it by tracing cables across photos with 'Cable Routing', 'Equipment Location', 'Meter Box' and similar captions on pages 4+.
verdicts.photo_observation: The DC cable (red line) is traced continuously from the roof PV area (page 15) along the parapet, across a covered terrace, and down an exterior wall into a ground-floor room where it reaches the Inverter/DCDB (page 18). A separate earthing route (orange/green lines) runs down a side alley to the earth pits (pages 19, 21). However, the AC cable segment from the ACDB/UPS point in the equipment room (page 18) to the Main/Solar meter box on the front porch (page 20) is not shown as one continuous overlaid line spanning both photos — the link between these two photos is implied by proximity rather than explicitly traced.
verdicts.rationale: Most of the run (roof to inverter, and earthing to pits) is clearly and continuously traced with marked lines, but the ACDB-to-meter-box AC cable segment crosses a photo boundary without an explicit connecting overlay, so full end-to-end continuity can't be fully confirmed from the documentation alone.
